input.summary: Extend licence to Licensee's Affiliates and contractors, make it transferable to a successor, and limit revocation to uncured material breach.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the grant to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf (we remain responsible for their compliance), confirmed transferability to a successor in an M&A transaction, and limited Licensor's ability to revoke the licence to an uncured material breach. As drafted the licence is usable only by Licensee's own employees and can be terminated immediately for any breach or on a change of control, which is not workable for our operations; if helpful, we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
ops.newText: grants to Licensee, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement: (i) use of the Licensed Technology by Licensee's Affiliates and by contractors acting on Licensee's behalf is permitted, and Licensee shall remain responsible for their compliance with this Agreement; (ii) the license granted under this Section is transferable, without Licensor's consent, to a successor to Licensee's business by merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, and shall not terminate as a result of any such transaction; and (iii) the license granted under this Section is not revocable at Licensor's discretion and may be terminated by Licensor only for a material breach by Licensee that remains uncured thirty (30) days after Licensor's written notice describing the breach.
